explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 96 named tracks and releases across Juno's live 14 September techno bestsellers and new-release pages, current Delsin/Moving Pressure/SK Eleven/Planet Rhythm material, adjacent minimal-house/electro windows and overlooked 1999-2008 catalogue reissues. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The canonical ledger, active discussions, revisit queue, rejected state, discoveries, target-local inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. No objective defect, active listener authorization, triggered revisit or open workflow repair required REPAIR.

Completed Runs 249-253 and vetoed Run 254 were compared before ranking. Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, scoped-REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded, including Rene Wise — Night Time Swim, Akufen — Architexture 3, Eddie Richards — Destiny and G Rush — Seduction.

The ranking spans current September 2026 releases, adjacent house/electro constructions and overlooked catalogue/reissue material. Candidate order reflects individual-track evidence, placement usefulness and information gain rather than novelty, artist diversity, genre status or resolver convenience.

Individual descriptions were kept separate from measured facts. No source wording was converted into inferred energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotion, phrase structure, mixability or transition quality. No proposed placement splits either protected internal handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.

Generic tags, bestseller status, artist reputation, release recency and bare titles were insufficient by themselves; Sawa and Carried remain removed and Tender Is The Night remains positively retained.
